blocking_findings.finding: The integration-facing extract_identity accepts PageText but checks only text length/content. It does not reject PageText.error/processing_error/truncated or enforce page_number order/43 page markers; a caller can therefore bypass the guards that revalidate applies through _text.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Validate PageText page numbers/order, error and truncated flags, and the per-page 43 footer markers inside extract_identity (or expose only a guarded page type/path), with regression tests.

blocking_findings.finding: extract_identity verifies artifact SHA and byte_len but not artifact URL binding or artifact_id/content relationship; direct integration can attach the fields to an artifact with a different URL.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require artifact.url_requested/url_final == DOCUMENT_URL (and explicit artifact identity policy) before emitting evidence, and test URL substitution through the typed helper.

conditional_gate: Do not promote until the two helper-path guards are fixed; after that, the typed module is otherwise ready to be wired through the source-specific dispatch and normal dry-run.
